digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI workflow routing and documentation gates
propositions: Documentation-only Gerrit changes must route to a reduced lane that skips OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs while retaining all documentation gates (ADR, index, cross-reference, quickstart, reference validation).

Routing decision (docs-only vs full) must execute only from trusted origin/main using sparse checkout with credentials disabled, never importing patchset-controlled logic, consuming only the exact patchset name-only diff as untrusted data via HEAD^..HEAD with fail-closed parent resolution.

Shared documentation gates must be extracted into a single composite action (.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml) with no inline copies, and every structural test consumer (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, etc.) must migrate to follow the extracted action without losing assertions.

Classifier job failure must block Verified even when full-route fallback jobs pass; docs-only job requires classifier success and route=docs-only output; any logical uncertainty (empty/malformed diff, parent resolution failure, non-allowlisted path) must emit route=full.

Documentation-only patchsets selected via allowlist must complete in significantly less wall-clock and runner-minutes than full Verify (measured against baseline run 31817494677), and genuine non-documentation changes must still execute the complete full test suite.
